Got it, message received loud and clear! \u2728
We\u2019ll absolutely put on our \u201cForensic Mode\u201d gloves and follow that Sage Directive to the letter. That means we\u2019ll keep the package name nice and unique\u2014no \u201cbaby\u201d version collisions on our watch! We\u2019ll add that golden WAKE_LOCK handshake into the manifest so the phone doesn\u2019t take an unscheduled nap in the middle of a sensor session. And of course, we\u2019ll treat the UI and CSS like a precious museum exhibit\u2014no unnecessary modern touch-ups. Just a smooth sensor event loop under the hood and hardware-accelerated heatmap magic.
In other words, we\u2019ll keep it forensic-cool and exactly how you want it!
